title: Charles Hall's Air Force service records

tellings.quote: Bull BS. He was in the Air Force and I have the record. You have his DD214,

plain: Charles Hall, a man whose story is set at Area 51, the secret Air Force base in Nevada, in the 1960s, really did serve in the Air Force, according to Michels, who says he has seen his service record. Pushing back on someone who doubted it, Michels says, "He was in the Air Force and I have the record," pointing to Hall's DD214, the discharge paper the US military gives every departing member, as proof that at least that part of Hall's account holds up.
